decisions.question: Invalid arguments (e.g. --run-date 2026-13-01): which exit code and message?
decisions.answer: Exit code 2 with a usage message

decisions.question: Which exit code for which problem, so the scheduler knows what happened (e.g. 0 ok, 1 error, 2 bad arguments, 3 input not ready)?

safety.question: Wrong values (nulls, negatives, out of range, wrong types, a column that changes type or disappears): what must never happen?

hazards.description: a null, negative or out-of-range value reaches the output
